svg.title: Klieg: one core, three surfaces
svg.desc: KliegKit's Collector builds one snapshot of herdr agents, OpenRig seats, queue items and pull requests, and three surfaces show it. In turn: Klieg.app's Board with four agent cards, one of them blocked asking to approve a command; the klieg status command printing the same agents, the queue item, PR ry-ops/klieg#3 and who needs you; and Claude calling the klieg_status MCP tool and getting the same picture back.
svg.text: Board · Needs You · Timeline · Pull Requests
status · timeline · herdr prompt · mcp install
12 tools for Claude, over stdio JSON-RPC

g.text: It's asking to approve a command.
Every card opens its live terminal in one click. Stop, merge and answering prompts ask first.
